_comment: Public on-chain data only (XO chain 3223, ERC-4337 v0.7 handleOps transactions, first UserOp of each), copied from docs/research/fixtures/gaps/userop-templates/txs by a one-off offline script. Bundler EOAs, gas prices and logs are left out. Owners come from the initCode (deployments) or from OwnerRegistered logs (docs/research/fixtures/gaps/userop-templates/owners.json). 22 operations, 158 golden checks in test/userop-golden.test.ts.
